correctness.rationale: The finite multinomial EGF coefficient formula is derived from the exact event that type i is absent until the final draw and every other type has appeared. The remaining EGF product is log-concave by a fully stated Toeplitz-TP2/Cauchy-Binet convolution argument. A two-by-two determinant identity then has nonnegative terms and an explicit strictly positive u=k-(m-2)+1,v=1 term for each k>=m-1 if m>=3. The m=2 delta-kernel case is checked directly. All positive-mass and quantifier boundary cases are covered. Exact rational EGF and finite-state DP checks agree across seven vectors through n=22, without treating finite checks as a proof.

originality.rationale: Closest published joint-law prior art is Brown–Peköz–Ross (2008), Proposition 1(f) and Section 4, which computes joint N,L probabilities and conditionally estimates tails but does not establish an all-probability, all-n strict pairwise MLR order. Aki–Hirano (2012), equation (5), provides an even broader joint waiting-time/rank model but its likelihood-ratio test addresses parameters, not ordered completion-time distributions. The positive-coefficient convolution and strict comparison are not covered by these distributional formulas alone. Published priority is not independently exhaustive.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible earlier result may formulate the same pairwise strict LR order under a different name.
Generic total-positivity theory, combined with the already published joint pmf, gives a short route to the result; priority of this exact specialization requires independent check.

value.rationale: The conditional law given final coupon identity is an expressly studied inferential object (Brown–Peköz–Ross 2008 Section 4). The result gives a universal sharp monotone-likelihood-ratio ordering and time-updated Bayesian odds for every pair, strictly stronger than a comparison of means or one tail. The theorem starts with universal equal posterior odds at minimum completion time m and thereafter shifts evidence toward rare final types, independently of all other probabilities. This is motivated structural information not supplied by tabulating the known joint distribution; no downstream theorem beyond stochastic order is claimed.
